subfamily: Collins (Codex p. 138: a sour served in a tall glass with ice and seltzer): vodka, measured fresh lime (or lemon, by taste), simple syrup, seltzer poured into the glass first, ice last (Codex p. 138 method)
glass: highball glass (about 350 ml), ice cubes added last
_status: v1 (Tomas, rework round 2, 2026-10-06). Replaces the bourbon Rickey (archived: work/regular-guy-ruler/mixologist-spec-rickey-2026-10-01.json). Not a Rickey: the classic Rickey has no sugar, and Oxford's sweetened variations take only 'a scant amount' (pdf 1661); here 20 ml of syrup (7.11 g/100 ml) is the balance. Short-shaken after the Codex (Oxford: most bartenders build and stir a Collins, pdf 2042). Near-miss owned: Just This Once's French 75, 'essentially a Champagne Tom Collins' (Oxford pdf 850). collins: 13.5% / 7.11 g / 0.758%, all in range. Sweeps: lime 17.5-27.5 in, 15 and 30 EDGE, 35 OUT; syrup 17.5-20 in, 22.5 EDGE, 15 and 25 OUT; vodka 37.5% 12.6 in, 43% 14.5 in, 50% OUT 16.8; seltzer 40 EDGE sugar, 60 in, 70 EDGE abv; melt after serving (probe work/regular-guy-ruler/mixologist-melt-probe.json) +10 in, +20 EDGE, +30 OUT. Lemon swap identical (LI pdf 140-141: both 6% acid, 1.6 g). Veto-free. Matrix consulted (Citrus pdf 80; Ginger pdf 132), set aside.
